description: Ranks DeFi pools by total APY from DefiLlama's public yields data, filtered by chain, minimum TVL and optional stablecoin-only, with each pool's TVL, 7-day impermanent loss, reward share of APY and IL-risk flag. Ranking is by APY, not by safety: there is no audit or exploit-history score (none is in this free source). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: Chain name as DefiLlama spells it, e.g. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum (default Base)

maxApyPct.description: Hide pools above this APY percent (default 1000); extreme APYs are usually reward-token artefacts

stablecoinOnly.description: true to list only stablecoin pools

name: agent_intel_defi_yield_risk_optimizer
title: Agent Intel Defi Yield Risk Optimizer
